tbesh_html:
1) to marry, possess, own, rule over
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to marry, be lord (husband) over
1b) (Niphal) to be married

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be master; hence, to marry
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife).
